notes: A follow-up to 3.4.0. The Lock Screen controls are findable now: 3.4.0 added steering from the Lock Screen, but those buttons only appear when Movement controls is switched on in Settings — and that setting is off by default, so most people had a feature with no way of knowing it existed. Spoofing with it off now shows a line on the live card, “Turn on Movement controls — joystick, routes, and steering from the Lock Screen”, which taps straight through to the setting. Shown only on GPS override, since the Wi-Fi engine can't be driven either way.
